hypothesis: Lagged returns of major cryptocurrencies contain information about next-week returns of other coins because common shocks diffuse slowly across the market. A causal rolling cross-crypto model should therefore rank subsequent weekly returns.
universe: Frozen ex-ante Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals listed by 2021-12-31, including later-delisted contracts where data exist. Each Monday retain top 50 by lagged trailing-30-day quote volume.
feature: For prediction week t, use the eight majors' realized Monday-open-to-Monday-open returns from week t-1. For each target coin fit a separate rolling ridge regression y_target,t ~ major_returns,t-1 using only the prior 52 target weeks, standardized inside that historical training window.
portfolio: Weekly market-neutral long top predicted-return quintile / short bottom predicted-return quintile, 0.5 gross per side.
execution: At Monday 00:00 UTC all model inputs and training targets end at the prior Monday/week. Rank contemporaneously eligible assets and execute at current Monday open, holding to next Monday open.
development_gate: Canonical mean rank IC >0.02 with HAC p<0.05, canonical net Sharpe >0.70 and total return >0, at least 2/3 ridge alphas positive after costs, and >=80 development weeks with predictions.
success_gate: Canonical OOS net Sharpe >1.0; OOS rank IC >0.02; positive at 2x costs; at least 2/3 alpha variants positive; 2024 and 2025 non-negative; max drawdown <35%; excluding BTC/ETH positive; excluding strongest contributor positive; DSR reported.
source_deviation: The paper uses adaptive LASSO/PCA and a broader predictor set. This preregistered implementation uses a fixed eight-major predictor panel and ridge regression to minimize model-selection degrees of freedom and keep all preprocessing causal.
